verdict.rationale: Exa documents asynchronous workloads: async deep research, list building and enrichment are named in pricing. Websets run long jobs toward a target item count and send HTTP webhook callbacks as items are added or enriched. However, nothing in the evidence shows a batch endpoint for submitting many search queries at once, so high-volume query workloads are only indirectly served through the async Agent/Websets products. Missing for 10: a batch query submission API, documented job status/polling semantics for the search API, high-volume throughput or rate-limit details, and independent hands-on corroboration of async job reliability.
